consent.title: Customer support is requesting access
consent.description: Customer support wants to access your store to help with support ticket #{{ticket}}. Only approve if you are actively working with support on this issue.
consent.code_hint: On the phone with support? Read them this code instead:
consent.error: Could not process your response. Please try again.
consent.access_read_only_hint: Support can look at your store but cannot change anything.
consent.access_full_hint: Support will be able to change data in your store on your behalf. Every action is recorded.

overlay.banner: Customer support is providing manual assistance for support ticket #{{ticket}}.
overlay.subtext: Your dashboard is temporarily locked while support is assisting. You stay in control — end the session anytime.
overlay.ended_toast: Support session ended. Your dashboard is unlocked.
